newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ FPI pushed up in Aug by meat, fish group.
newsitem.headline: NZ FPI pushed up in Aug by meat, fish group.

text.p: New Zealand food prices rose 0.4 percent in August bringing the annual rise to 2.4 percent, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
Meat, fish and poultry prices, which increased 1.8 percent between July and August were the main contributor to the price rise.
August was the second month since July 1993 to record a price rise of over 1.0 percent in the meat, fish, and poultry group.
Grocery prices rose 0.4 percent, mainly as a result of higher prices for fruit drinks, cakes and buns.
